name: Yaguchi Kei
source:
A second-year student at K Middle School. He was privately tutored by Akito.

Well-bred yet timid. 
He is good friends with [url=https://vndb.org/c93031]Jirou[/url].

Since Akito recommended him to read mystery novels, the two often discuss them together. 

[Translated from [url=http://creo.main.jp/page/product/loot/Character/loot_cha_kei.html]official website[/url]]
